title: Patient Encounter Performance Rubric
note: Stand-in built from the project plan (section 6). Replace with the rubric JSON supplied by the challenge organisers; keep the same keys.
total_is: A discussion aid, not a pass/fail grade.

domains.name: Opening and purpose
domains.description: Introduces self and role, confirms who the patient is, and sets the agenda for the visit.

domains.name: Rapport, respect, and empathy
domains.description: Treats the patient with respect, builds trust, and responds to emotion with empathy, especially when the patient is being difficult.

domains.name: Information gathering
domains.description: Probes with good questions: open before closed, concrete and non-judgmental, and thorough enough to uncover what matters.

domains.name: Listening and response to cues
domains.description: Notices and follows up on verbal and non-verbal cues, including inconsistencies between what the patient says and what the chart shows.

domains.name: Explanation and shared decisions
domains.description: Explains results and delivers hard news clearly and kindly, checks understanding, and involves the patient in decisions.

domains.name: Clinical reasoning and synthesis
domains.description: Pulls the history and chart together into an accurate picture of the clinical findings.

domains.name: Professionalism, safety, and closure
domains.description: Stays professional and safe, and ends the visit clearly with next steps.
